blocks.name: DiagnosticEventAvailableCaller
blocks.maskDescription:
Call an AUTOSAR Diagnostic Event Manager (Dem) service function.

Set the client port name parameter to the port name used by the component for the function call.

Select a Dem operation with the Operation parameter. After the selection, the block inputs and outputs correspond to the input and output arguments of the selected operation.

blocks.name: Dem Status Inject
blocks.maskDescription:
Set the diagnostic status for an AUTOSAR event simulated in the Diagnostic Service Component block. This status value can be configured according to the Unified Diagnostic Services (UDS) standard.

Inhibition conditions defined in the FiM tab of the Diagnostic Service Component by using an overriding ID trigger appropriately as the overriding value changes.

This block simulates along with other blocks affecting this status.

blocks.name: Dem Status Override
blocks.maskDescription:
Set the diagnostic status for an AUTOSAR event simulated in the Diagnostic Service Component block. This status value can be configured according to the Unified Diagnostic Services (UDS) standard.

Inhibition conditions defined in the FiM tab of the Diagnostic Service Component by using an overriding ID trigger appropriately as the overriding value changes.

Other blocks that attempt to modify this status during simulation are ignored.

blocks.name: Curve
blocks.maskDescription:
Perform one-dimensional interpolated table lookup, including index searches. The table is a sampled representation of a function. Breakpoint sets relate the input values to positions in the table.

When the AUTOSAR 4.x code replacement library (CRL) is selected for the model, code generated from this block is replaced by the AUTOSAR library routine indicated below.

blocks.name: Curve Using Prelookup
blocks.maskDescription:
Perform interpolation on a one-dimensional table using precalculated index and fraction values provided by a Prelookup block.

When the AUTOSAR 4.x code replacement library (CRL) is selected for the model, code generated from this block is replaced by the AUTOSAR library routine indicated below.

blocks.name: Map
blocks.maskDescription:
Perform two-dimensional interpolated table lookup, including index searches. The table is a sampled representation of a function in two variables. Breakpoint sets relate the input values to positions in the table.

When the AUTOSAR 4.x code replacement library (CRL) is selected for the model, code generated from this block is replaced by the AUTOSAR library routine indicated below.

blocks.name: Map Using Prelookup
blocks.maskDescription:
Perform interpolation on a two-dimensional table using precalculated index and fraction values provided by a Prelookup block.

When the AUTOSAR 4.x code replacement library (CRL) is selected for the model, code generated from this block is replaced by the AUTOSAR library routine indicated below.

blocks.name: Prelookup
blocks.maskDescription:
Compute the index and fraction for a Curve Using Prelookup block or a Map Using Prelookup block. Locate the position of input "u" on the set of intervals defined by "Breakpoint data". The output index and fraction is defined as a bus that specifies the interval containing the input and the normalized position of the input on the interval.

When the AUTOSAR 4.x code replacement library (CRL) is selected for the model, code generated from this block is replaced by the AUTOSAR library routine indicated below.

blocks.name: Single Point Interpolation
blocks.maskDescription:
Perform a single-point interpolation as defined by equation y = u1 + f*(u2-u1).

Compatible with AUTOSAR Ifl_Interpolate_f32 routine.

blocks.name: Ramp
blocks.maskDescription:
Output a ramp signal that follows the input value bounded by a rising or falling slope. The initial output is equal to the initial condition. "Rise slope" (rs) and "Fall slope" (fs) are used to compute the rate at which the output reaches the target input (u). When "Show reset port" (R) is true, the output value is reset to the initial condition.

When the AUTOSAR 4.x code replacement library (CRL) is selected for the model, code generated from this block is replaced by Mfl_RampInitState, Mfl_RampSetParam, Mfl_RampCalc, and Mfl_RampOut_f32 routines.
